content: Kohya sd-scripts TOML dataset config: [general] holds shuffle_caption/caption_extension/keep_tokens/resolution; [[datasets]] holds resolution/batch_size/enable_bucket/validation_split; [[datasets.subsets]] DreamBooth-style requires image_dir (images directly inside) with .txt caption sidecars (caption_extension='.txt') or class_tokens; fine-tuning style requires metadata_file (=--in_json). KEY: caption_metadata_file is NOT a valid key - voluptuous schema raises 'extra keys not allowed'. validation_split IS a native dataset-level option. enable_bucket recommended for mixed aspect ratios. Config file values take priority over CLI args.
